content: Yuhuda Kawo Azaryaasa
Isra7eele kawo Iyorba7aamey kawotida nam7u tammanne laappunththa layththan Yuhuda kawo Amasiyaase naa Azaariyaasi kawotides.
Izi kawotiza wode izas layththay 16; izi Yerusalaame ichchash tammanne nam7u layth haarides; iza aaya Yikolyay Yerusalaame maccassa.
Kase iza aawa Amasiyaasi ooththoyssaththo Azaariyaasikka GODAA sinththan lo7o ooso ooththides.
Gido attiin zumbullata bolla goynnizasahoti dhaybeettenna; asaykka heen yarsho shiishonne exaane cuwaseth aggibeenna.

GODAY kawoza izi hayqqana gakkanaas iza bolla inchchirachcha harge yeggides; izikka asappe shaakettidi dumma keeththan uttides; he wode iza kawoteththa keeththaa alaafeteththan deraa ayssizay kawoza naa Iyo7aatame.
Azaariyaasa kawoteththa layththan oosettidaazinne hanida hanoti ubbay Yuhuda Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetti dees gidennee?
Azaariyaasi hayqqidi ba aawatan gayttides; Dawite katamaan iza aawata duufo matan iza moogida; iza naa Iyo7aatamey izasohon kawotides.
Isra7eele Kawo Zakaraasa
Yuhuda kawo Azaariyaasi kawotida heedzdzu tammanne osppunththa layththan Iyorba7aame naa Zakaraasi Samaariya kataman Isra7eelen kawotides; 6 aginakka haarides.
Kase iza aaway ooththoyssaththo izikka GODAA sinththan iita miish ooththides; Nabaaxe naa Iyorba7aamey Isra7eele asaa oosisida nagaraappe izi simmibeenna.
Yaabuse naa Shaloomey Zakaraasa bolla dendidi deraa sinththan iza bolla meto gaththi wodhides; iza sohonkka kawotides.
Zakaraasa kawoteththa layththatan oosettida hara miishshatikka Isra7eele kawota taarike maxaafan xaafettida.
Kase GODAY Iyus, «Ne nayti oydanththa yeleta gakkanaas Isra7eele kawoteththa araatan uttana» giidi yootida qaalay polettides.
Isra7eele Kawo Shaloome
Yuhuda kawo Ooziyay kawotida heedzdzu tammanne uddufunththo layththan Yaabuse naa Shaloomey Isra7eele bolla kawotides. Samaariyan uttidi issi agina deraa haarides.
Gaade naa Minaheemi Tirxxafe kezi Samaariya biidi meto gaththides; Yaabuse naa Shaloome wodhidi izasohon kawotides.
Shaloome kawoteththa layththatan oosettida hara oosotinne izi denththeththida yo7oti Isra7eele kawota taarike maxaafan xaafettida.
Isra7eele Kawo Minaheeme

He wode Minaheemi Tirxxafe kezidi Tifisa katama asaanne he heeran diza asaa ubbaa bolla meto gaththides; izi hessaththo ooththiday istti he katamay pengeta doyontta ixxida gishshassa; Tifisa asaa wodhidessinne shaarara diza maccassata ubbata ulo daakkides.
Yuhuda kawo Azaariyaasi kawotida heedzdzu tammanne uddufunththo layththan Gaade naa Minaheemi Isra7eele bolla kawotides; izi Samaariyan uttidi 10 layth haarides.
Izi GODAA sinththan iita miish ooththides; izi ba diza layth ubbaan Nabaaxe naa Iyorba7aamey Isra7eele asaa oosisida nagaraappe simmibeenna.
Hessafe guye Asoore kawo Teligelitelifelisoorey biittayo oli oykkides; Minaheemikka baas maado demmanaasinne ba kawoteththan diza ba zawa minththanaas giidi 1,000 saqile bira izas immides.

Minaheemi he miishshaa Isra7eele asay kesetti shiishshana mala ooththides; izi hessaththo ooththiday miishshaza Asoore kawos immana mala dure asay issoy issoy 50 saqile bira kessana mala wolqqaththides; hessa gishshas Asoore kawoy he deren gam7ontta ba dere simmi bides.
Minaheeme kawoteththa layththan oosettida hara oosotinne hanida hanoti ubbay Isra7eele kawota taarike maxaafan xaafetti dees gidennee?
Minaheemi hayqqidi ba aawatan gayttides; iza naa Fiqaseyaasi izasohon kawotides.
Yuhuda kawo Azaariyaasi kawotida ichchash tammanththa layththan Minaheeme naa Fiqaseyaasi Samaariya kataman Isra7eele bolla kawotidi 2 layth haarides.
Fiqaseyaasi GODAA sinththan iita ooththides; Nabaaxe naa Iyorba7aamey Isra7eele asaa oosisida nagaraappe simmibeenna.

Iza ola asaa halaqatappe issoy Eromeliyo naa Faaquhey iza bolla dendides; Gala7aadeppe 50 as ba bolla ekki biidi Samaariyan kawo keeththan diza miixan Fiqaseyaase, Argobanne Arayara issife wodhidi izasohon kawotides.
Fiqaseyaasa kawoteththa layththan oosettida hara oosotinne hanida hanoti ubbay Isra7eele kawota taarike maxaafan xaafettides.
Isra7eele Kawo Faaquhe
Yuhuda kawo Azaariyaasi kawotida ichchash tammanne nam7anththo layththan Eromeliyo naa Faaquhey Samaariya kataman Isra7eele asaa bolla kawotides; 20 layth kawotides.
Izikka GODAA sinththan iita miish ooththides; Nabaaxe naa Iyorba7aamey Isra7eele asaa oosisida nagaraappe simmibeenna.

Isra7eele kawo Faaquhey kawoti diza layththatan Asoore kawo Teligelitelifelisoorey yiidi Iyoone, Aabeeli-Beeti-Ma7ika, Yaanooke, Qaadeese, Haxoore, Gala7aade, Galilanne Niftaaleme deraakka issife gaththi oykkides. Asaakka di7i ekkidi Asoore dere efides.

Hessafe guye Eela naa Hose7ey Eromeliyo naa Faaquhe bolla dereza denththides; iza bolla meto gaththidi wodhides; Ooziya naa Iyo7aatamey kawotida nam7u tammanththa layththan Hose7ey Faaquhe sohon kawotides.
Faaquhe kawoteththa layththatan oosettida hara oosotinne hanida hanoti ubbay Isra7eele kawota taarike maxaafan xaafetti dees gidennee?
Yuhuda Kawo Iyo7aatame
Isra7eele kawo Eromeliyo naa Faaquhey kawotida nam7anththo layththan Yuhuda kawo Ooziya naa Iyo7aatamey kawotides.
Izi kawotiza wode izas layththay 25; izi Yerusalaamen uttidi 16 layth haarides. Iza aaya Saadooqe naa Iyeruso geetettawus.
Izi kase ba aawa Ooziyay ooththida mala GODAA sinththan lo7o ooso ooththides.
Gido attiin zumbullata bollan goynnizasohoti kichchibeettenna; asay heen yarsho shiishonne exaane cuwaseth aggibeenna. Iyo7aatamey GODAA Keeththas pude bagga pengeza zaari giigsides.
Iyo7aatame kawoteththa layththatan oosettida hara oosotinne hanida hanoti ubbay Yuhuda Kawota Taarike Maxaafan xaafetti dees gidennee?
He wode GODAY Aaraame kawo Eraasooneynne Eromeliyo naa Faaquhey Yuhuda olana mala ooththides.
Iyo7aatamey hayqqidi ba aawatan gayttides; kase iza aawati moogettida duufon ba aawa Dawite katamaan moogettides. Iza naa Akaazey izasohon kawotides.
